title: Final Distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the distance from the camera (u) as 297 cm.

title: Final Resolution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the best resolution obtainable on the film (Delta x) as 3.1 x 10^-3 cm.

title: Lens Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the lens formula 1/u + 1/v = 1/f correctly.

title: Magnification Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the magnification (m) from the height of the object and image.

title: Angular Resolution Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should use the angular resolving power formula Delta theta = 1.22 lambda / D appropriately.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the lens formula calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any factors when calculating Delta x from Delta theta.
